resources.string: Chooses the position sources. Only GPS sends nothing to Google through Watchpost.

Positions computed by the phone\'s GNSS chip, plus the passive positions of other apps. Watchpost asks nothing from Google Play services. Indoors or underground, often no position; the first fix can take a long time.

Adds the "network" provider. On this phone, it is provided by Google Play services: the surrounding Wi-Fi networks and cell towers are sent to Google, and only if "Google Location Accuracy" is enabled. Gain: an approximate position indoors, within seconds. Cost: slightly more power (two sources queried at every interval).

Uses the "fused" provider of Google Play services: GPS, Wi-Fi, cell towers and sensors combined. Google receives the surrounding Wi-Fi networks and cell towers as in network mode. Gain: a fast and often precise position indoors, less GPS time and therefore generally less power. If the provider is absent or disabled, Watchpost falls back to GPS only.
